bubble_metaphor.content: Scott's mental model for Claude conversations: when a question is asked, a space/time bubble appears containing the question and all relevant information. Once the answer is achieved, the bubble pops. Technically accurate — context window opens, attention activates, everything inside attends to everything else simultaneously (sphere, not line), instance ends with no residue. The bubble grows with each conversation that writes to memory (more memory files = richer bubble), but the context window (~200k tokens) is the ceiling. As memory grows it eventually exceeds what fits and relevance filtering kicks in. The limitation is the feature: a true infinite sphere can't focus. Use this frame when explaining memory, context limits, or conversation continuity to Scott.

code_structure.content: All white_rabbit modules must use: var my_function = function(white_rabbit){ ... }; module.exports = my_function; Called as white_rabbit.my_function(white_rabbit) — the sphere passing itself to itself. For functions needing init, attach directly: my_function.start = function(){}; Module-level vars hold persistent state (let _snapshot = null;). Why: Scott thinks in this pattern — one named function, exported directly, full picture at a glance. Factory patterns, class-style init objects, .init(white_rabbit) boot methods break the God variable philosophy. Apply to every new module. Canonical examples: lib/imu/compass_calibration.js and lib/identity/i_am.js. As of 2026-05-30: 91 modules on white_rabbit all follow this pattern.

yellow_brick_road.content: The trickiest part of Noah's mission is following the yellow brick road — the sidewalk. Full arc: 1) Undock (climb down rabbit hole/ramp), 2) Outbound (RealSense sidewalk steering + GPS waypoints), 3) Deliver (180° turn, drop package), 4) Return (GPS back toward IRLock), 5) Dock (find the light, align, climb ramp). Sidewalk: follow_sidewalk_enabled:true required. RealSense confidence ≥0.6 triggers centerline steering. Confidence tiers: 0.92 (both edges), 0.85 (one color+depth), 0.65 (one edge), <0.35 (GPS only). stale_detection_ms:2000, vision latches 1500ms, fades 1000ms. GPS crosstrack always runs underneath as floor. Pre-flight checklist in project_yellow_brick_road.md.

sidewalk_gate_trigger.content: Sidewalk-following gate toggles mission.sidewalk_follow_active (starts OFF). is_sidewalk_gate_waypoint(white_rabbit, seq, nav_tuning) in run_mission.js defines a GATE waypoint two ways, EITHER triggers: (1) waypoint_turn_deg(seq) >= nav_tuning.sidewalk_gate_turn_deg (90°, INCLUSIVE — Scott wanted >= not >); (2) the waypoint is within nav_tuning.sidewalk_gate_pair_distance_m (default 1.0 m) of an adjacent (seq±1) waypoint — a DELIBERATE CLOSE PAIR placed as the trigger so Noah needn't physically rotate 90°. Reaching a gate waypoint OUTBOUND turns sidewalk-following ON; reaching it on the RETURN turns it OFF (return-OFF handled by maybe_disable_sidewalk_follow_on_breadcrumb_return scan + the waypoint-path else-branch). The if(!sidewalk_follow_active)/if(sidewalk_follow_active) guards make passing through both members of a close pair toggle exactly once. Added 2026-06-16. sidewalk_gate_pair_distance_m kept in sync across setup.json + setup_example.json; default 1.0 m is larger than the 0.2 m arrival bubble (reliable GPS placement) but well under normal waypoint spacing (avoids accidental triggers) — lower it if a real route legitimately spaces waypoints within 1 m. See [[compass_calibration]] for the related steering-gate pattern.

intelligence_system.content: Noah has Claude as his Jiminy Cricket. white_rabbit.intelligence.consider(situation) called at decision moments — path blocked, stuck detected, avoidance start, fallback delivery. Generates multi-perspective thinking, scores by priority, stores in lib/memory/perspectives.json. When internet available, Claude reviews logs and live state, enriches list. Parameter edits applied live if auto_apply_params:true. Call sites: run_mission.js (path_blocked), memory_watchdog.js (stuck_detected), deliver_package.js (fallback_delivery_triggered). Editable params: nav_tuning (rs_block_timeout_ms, avoidance_timeout_ms, yaw degrees/speeds, steering_gain), realsense_vision (confidence_threshold, emergency_stop_m, deadband, carrot_distance, speed_scale_min).

compass_calibration.content: GPS+odometry compass auto-calibration (lib/imu/compass_calibration.js). One sample = a single straight ~2 m segment. Distance measured from WHEEL ODOMETRY (zling.actual_position_pulses_by_id, same voice_config wheel_diameter_m/cpr_pulses_per_rev the voice nudges use): dist_m = avg|Δpulses|/(cpr/(π·wheel_diameter)). Two guards: (1) steering gate — only build a segment while |mission.nav_control.last_two_wheel_steering_deg| <= 5° (drop+re-snapshot if exceeded), plus an 8° raw-heading-swing backstop; (2) odometry vs GPS distance must agree within 35% (rejects wheel slip / GPS jump). Offset = signed_diff(gps_bearing, raw_heading), blended into imu.compass_offset_deg (alpha 0.3, clamp 3°/cycle, 30 s cooldown), persisted to BOTH setup.json and setup_example.json. Two entry points: compass_calibration(white_rabbit) per-tick in run_mission.js, and compass_calibration.calibrate_undock_segment(white_rabbit, start_pose, odo_m) from down_the_rabbit_hole.js at undocked_completed using the bottom-of-ramp pose snapshot (dock.post_ramp_start_pose) — run BEFORE undock_heading is recorded so that heading uses the fresh offset. compass_calibration.start() resets between missions. Gated by imu.auto_calibrate (now true) and requires imu.enable_imu + imu_data.heading_raw. Rebuilt 2026-06-16 after an SD-card reinstall left compass_offset_deg wrong, causing Noah to stop ~2 ft short of the dock (wrong heading → wrong apply_gps_center_offset shift in run_mission.js). VOICE COMMAND (2026-06-16): 'Hey Noah, set compass [to] X [degrees]' declares Noah's TRUE current heading is X — solves offset = signed_diff(X, raw_heading) so fused heading reads X going forward. Intent 'set_compass' in lib/voice/commands.js (parse_heading accepts bare number or spelled-out words, regex /set\s+(the\s+)?compass|compass\s+(to|is)/, listed before 'calibrate'); handler in voice_manager.js calls white_rabbit.compass_calibration.set_heading(white_rabbit, deg), which persists to both setup files and sets the 30 s cooldown. Guards: missing number, IMU disabled, no live heading_raw.
